newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska corn, sorghum harvest progress quickly.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska corn, sorghum harvest progress quickly.

text.p: Wintry weather halted or slowed harvest and tillage operations in Nebraska during the later part of the week ended Sunday, according to the latest crop report from the state's Agricultural Statistics Service.
Corn was 93 pecent harvested. That figure compared with 94 percent last year and the five-year average of 87 percent.
Sorghum grain harvest was 88 percent complete, well behind 100 percent last year and also behind the average pace of 96 percent, the report said.
The winter wheat crop was rated 69 percent good to excellent, 28 percent fair and 3 percent poor.
Topsoil moisture was rated nil very short, 22 percent short, 74 percent adequate and four percent surplus. There were 4.8 days suitable for fieldwork, the state agency said.
